name: The Watching Pool
legend: # = wall, . = floor, P = player start, D = door slot (in the outer wall), C = chest, S = rest shrine
waves_note: Enemies arrive in waves: the next wave comes when 1 enemy (or none) is left.
artProps: Layout copied from keepers-hall. Theme and props from the quiet-river draft room "watching-pool". A wide shallow pool with stepping stones; a tall water heron stands in the middle, its feathers streaked with mud.
signs: Be still, and the water clears.
Even a heron likes kind words.
